groups.operation: Dump a value returned by json_loadb through do_dump.
groups.condition: The loaded value reaches the new dump depth limit.
groups.capability: json_loadb and parse_json must admit a value that reaches the do_dump guard.
groups.consequence: Dumping returns failure at the depth limit.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns depth-limit rejection during dumping.

groups.operation: Call json_dumps with nonzero JSON_MAX_INDENT flags.
groups.condition: Indentation flags are supported, but the harness clears JSON_MAX_INDENT before calling json_dumps.
groups.capability: json_dumps must receive the indentation flags and pass them through do_dump to dump_indent.
groups.consequence: Indented string output is unreachable through that harness call.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns indentation flags and formatted output, not depth-limit rejection.
